statements.status_notes: log4j-api is shaded inside the co.elastic.apm:elastic-apm-agent-java8 fat jar shipped in modules/apm. Gradle resolutionStrategy cannot rewrite classes inside that pre-built jar. The latest published elastic-apm-agent-java8 release (1.56.0) embeds log4j-api 2.26.0; CVE-2026-49844 is fixed in 2.26.1 and no newer APM agent release is available yet. The main Elasticsearch distribution already resolves log4j 2.26.1; only the optional APM agent module retains the older embedded copy.
